note: Verified-outcomes ledger for data/market-calendar.json, read only by scripts/apply-calendar-outcomes.cjs. An entry counts as verified ONLY when decision, reaction, source, and verifiedAt are all present and non-empty; anything less is ignored and the event is left open (fail closed). Keys use the same event id scheme as scripts/sync-market-events.cjs: <type>-<date>. Entries are curated from figures the brief pipeline has already verified (Jun's graded event record); the narrative brief itself is prose and is never scraped for figures. Provenance (source/verifiedAt) stays in this ledger — the calendar outcome schema carries only decision + reaction.

cpi-2026-10-14.decision: September CPI printed hot (BLS, Oct 14, 8:30 AM ET): headline +0.6% m/m, 3.7% y/y; core +0.3% m/m, 2.6% y/y — core a tenth above the +0.2% consensus anchor, with gasoline (+9.1% m/m) driving over half the headline increase.
cpi-2026-10-14.reaction: The 10-year spiked ~9bp intraday to ~5.31% but closed Oct 14 at 5.19% — inside the 5.2–5.5% containment band, not a falsifier trip. October hike odds repriced from ~22% to roughly 40% for the Oct 27–28 FOMC. Bank credit did not crack on the print (BAC's drop was a $1.2B Treasury settlement charge, not provisions).
cpi-2026-10-14.source: Jun's verified record: Oct 14, 2026 CPI grading (print, gasoline share, hike-odds repricing, BAC settlement charge) and Oct 16 Friday thesis bond section (10Y Oct 14 cash close 5.19%). Prepared as research_notes/capradar-calendar-outcome-draft-2026-10-17.md.

fomc-2026-10-28.decision: Held the federal funds target range at 3.75–4.00% on a 10-2 vote — Hammack and Cook dissented in favor of a 25bp hike. Statement: inflation remains elevated relative to 2%; activity expanding at a solid pace. IORB unchanged at 3.90%.
fomc-2026-10-28.reaction: Muted: S&P 500 +0.28% to 7,743.98, VIX 16.91, 10Y 5.05%. Two hawkish dissents kept December live — CME FedWatch priced ~83% odds of a 25bp December hike after the decision. Minutes due Nov 18.
fomc-2026-10-28.source: Federal Reserve FOMC statement Oct 28, 2026 (federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/files/monetary20261028a1.pdf); Fox Business / Advisor Perspectives decision coverage; index, VIX and 10Y closes from data/cache equity-ownership, volatility, duration series.

election-2026-11-03.decision: Democrats won control of both chambers (AP calls): the Senate flipped from a 53-47 Republican majority, and the House flipped with Hakeem Jeffries in line for Speaker. Result is divided government for the last two years of the Trump term; no veto-proof majority.
election-2026-11-03.reaction: Clean, uncontested outcome — the post-midterm base rate (gridlock continuity) applies. S&P 500 +1.58% on Nov 4 to 7,688.62 and VIX fell 20.83 → 16.61; the relief did not hold — the index dropped 4.36% the next day on the AI-capex selloff, unrelated to the vote.
election-2026-11-03.source: AP race calls via CNBC (cnbc.com/2026/11/04/2026-midterm-election-results-live-updates.html) and CBS News Senate results; index and VIX closes from data/cache equity-ownership and volatility series.

jobs-2026-11-06.decision: October payrolls +165K vs ~65K consensus; unemployment 4.1% (vs 4.2% expected); average hourly earnings +0.4% m/m, +3.1% y/y; participation 61.9%. August–September revised up a combined 84K. Soft spots: U-6 rose to 7.9% from 7.6%; part-time jobs +339K.
jobs-2026-11-06.reaction: Hawkish: 10Y +3bp to ~4.87%, 2Y +6bp to ~4.53%, dollar index +0.7%; December hike odds rose to ~78% from 70% (LSEG). Equities bounced anyway after Thursday's rout — S&P 500 +0.31% to 7,376.86, Nasdaq +1.1% — but the S&P lost 2.7% on the week.
jobs-2026-11-06.source: BLS Employment Situation Oct 2026 (bls.gov/news.release/pdf/empsit.pdf); Benzinga and Babypips release coverage; Reuters via Investing.com for yield/odds reaction; S&P close cross-checked against data/cache equity-ownership series (7,376.86).

cpi-2026-11-10.decision: October CPI +0.4% m/m vs +0.3% consensus (September +0.6%); core +0.3% m/m vs +0.2% consensus (second straight 0.3%). No 12-month rate published — BLS has no October 2025 baseline after the 2025 shutdown. Shelter +0.3% (>30% of the headline gain); energy +0.7% (gasoline +1.0%, electricity +0.9%); food +0.5%; transportation services +0.8%; used cars -1.2%.
cpi-2026-11-10.reaction: Hawkish: CME FedWatch fully priced a 25bp December hike and 50bp odds rose to ~14% from ~0. S&P 500 -0.38% to 7,520.93 (off an intraday low near -0.7%); VIX 19.92 to 19.46; MOVE 85.98 to 92.43; DXY +0.6% to 102.23. Equities recovered next session: S&P +1.31% to 7,619.38 on Nov 11, VIX 17.49.
cpi-2026-11-10.source: BLS CPI release Oct 2026 via CNBC (cnbc.com/2026/11/10/cpi-inflation-report-october-2026.html); Quartz and FXStreet release coverage; S&P/VIX/MOVE/DXY closes cross-checked against data/cache equity-ownership, volatility and fx-dollar series.
